jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(2)(B) inventory: the Colchester Supervisory District's district is the Colchester School District (member town: Colchester).

sources.note: Colchester School District School Board Member Directory (official): five directors -- Lindsey Cox (Chair, 3-year term expiring March 2029), Nic Longo (Vice Chair, 3-year, 2028), Ben Yousey-Hindes (Clerk, 2-year, 2027), Laurie Kigonya (3-year, 2027), Jennifer Fath (2-year, 2028). The same five are in attendance in the October 6, 2026 board minutes. The mix (three 3-year seats, two 2-year seats) is the 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b) town-district shape.
